recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reintroducing the interim ConceptMap2 direction would now be misleading because the temporary transition is complete; any future edits should be handled as separate ConceptMap redesign or cleanup issues.
issue_request: FHIR-32854 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ConceptMap change request from the Vocabulary WG for R5. It requested text on the current R5 ConceptMap page stating that the page was interim, not final for R5, and directing readers to ConceptMap2 for the latest features.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-32854 was found. Commit 9e9b97453f45d60fcf7e9eaf6d6f4d27b7aa7a7c effectively applied the request by adding a dragon warning block to source/conceptmap/conceptmap-introduction.xml that directed readers from ConceptMap to ConceptMap2 until replacement was complete.
additional_context: FHIR-32854 was part of the same temporary transition as FHIR-32853 and FHIR-32855. Commit 8623473ddfcef0cb88b9abf5241abfe6e28ea542 moved ConceptMap2 content into ConceptMap and removed active conceptmap2 entries from source/fhir.ini. FHIR-37789 then requested removal of the stale warning, and commit 033afec42bc0ba06167b7f99866ff81092fcdd9e removed it. The combined branch already has separate reconciliation commits for FHIR-32855 and FHIR-37789.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build has conceptmap=ConceptMap active, no active ConceptMap2 resource, no ConceptMap2/dragon/interim redirect text in current ConceptMap source, and only a remaining R4-to-R5 redesign implementation note that is accurate without referring to the temporary resource.

related_jiras.note: Created the temporary ConceptMap2 resource that the FHIR-32854 warning pointed readers toward.
Completed the ConceptMap2-to-ConceptMap replacement and discarded ConceptMap2; already represented on the combined branch.
Requested removing the obsolete ConceptMap2 dragon warning after the transition completed; already represented on the combined branch.
